chunks: From him, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Regarding the fetus of a beast, if it is struck and it miscarries, one-tenth of its price is due.”

key_terms.جَنِينِ: the fetus carried in the womb
key_terms.فَأَلْقَتْ: then cast out its fetus or miscarried

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for causing a pregnant animal to miscarry in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning injury to a pregnant animal that causes it to cast its fetus. It establishes financial liability, specifying that compensation is one-tenth of the animal’s price. The report reflects Islamic jurisprudential concern for property rights and harms done to animals.
